title: bzf consumption
description: Measured consumption of a building, `consumption/<id>.json`: its meters and the amounts read or billed per period, each with where it came from (a bill among the received files). It is what a consumption-based Energieausweis takes, what the EPBD's Annex V may show as metered consumption and its databases hold (Art. 22), and the logbook's operation and use. Consumption of a home tells about the people in it, so it is shared only with the owner's consent like every building document. This schema describes documents of schema version 1.x; a document of another major version is only required to say which.

periods.description: Amounts read or billed, oldest first.

vacancy.description: Periods the building or part of it stood empty, as a share of its area, which a consumption-based method corrects for.

share.description: The share of the area that stood empty, as a fraction.

meter.description: A meter, or a supply billed without one (oil by delivery, wood by the stere).

services.description: What its carrier is used for, where known. Where listed, it says whether the amounts of this meter hold the energy that heats water: with `hotWater` they do (a central system that heats water too; a period's `hotWater` gives the share where a bill states it), without it they do not. Where every meter of the document lists its services and none lists `hotWater`, water is heated apart from the consumption recorded here (decentrally, as by electric instantaneous heaters). Where a meter does not list them, whether its amounts hold hot water is not known.

system.description: The meter in the building's systems, where it is one.

serves.description: The parts or spaces it measures; all of the building where absent.

period.description: An amount over a period: as read from the meter, as billed, or estimated.

carrier.description: Where it has no meter, its carrier.

unit.description: The unit the amount is in, as read or billed: kWh, MWh, m³, l, kg, t, rm (stacked cubic metres), srm (loose cubic metres).

source.description: Where it came from: the bill among the received files.

calorificBasis.description: The calorific basis of the period's energy figures (an `amount` or a `hotWater` share in kWh or MWh, and `calorificValue`), as the bill states it: `gross`, the gross calorific value (Brennwert, Hs), on which gas bills usually state kWh; `net`, the net calorific value (Heizwert, Hi). Absent where the bill does not say; a method then takes its own rule and says which. Since 0.4.

calorificValue.description: The energy one unit of the amount holds, kWh per `unit` (m³, l, kg, t, rm, srm), on `calorificBasis`, as the bill or the supplier states it: for gas, the billing calorific value times the volume correction factor (Abrechnungsbrennwert × Zustandszahl). Not given for an amount in kWh or MWh. Absent, a method takes a value for the carrier from its own tables. Since 0.4.

woodType.description: The kind of wood, for log wood (`logWood`) billed by volume (`rm`, `srm`), which decides what a cubic metre weighs: `hardwood` (beech, oak), `softwood` (spruce, pine), `mixed`. Since 0.4.

hotWater.description: The part of `amount` that heated water, as a bill states it (the hot-water share of a heating cost statement, Heizkostenabrechnung), in `hotWaterUnit` or else the period's `unit`, on the same calorific basis; at most `amount` where both are in one unit. Given only for a meter whose `services` hold `hotWater`. Absent, the share is not stated, which does not mean that it is zero. Since 0.4.

hotWaterUnit.description: The unit of `hotWater` where the bill states the share in another unit than the amount: oil billed in litres, its hot-water share in kWh. Since 0.4.
